source: Lightly Armored
Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with light armor.
Linguist

Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages and can create written ciphers that others cannot read without an Intelligence check against a DC of 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and proficiency bonus.
Lucky

You have three luck points, regained on a long rest. Spend one to roll an extra d20 on your own attack roll, ability check or saving throw and choose which die to use, or to roll an extra d20 on an attack made against you and choose which the attacker uses.
Magic Initiate

Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list. Choose one 1st-level spell from the same list: you learn it and can cast it once without expending a spell slot, at its lowest level, and again after a long rest. Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for bard, sorcerer or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; Intelligence for wizard.
Mage Slayer

When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell you can use your reaction to attack it. When you damage a creature concentrating on a spell it has disadvantage on the concentration save, and you have advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet.
Martial Adept
You learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master list and gain one superiority die of d6, which refills on a short or long rest.
Medium Armor Master
Wearing medium armor does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks, and if your Dexterity is 16 or higher you add 3 rather than 2 to your AC from medium armor.
Mobile

Your speed increases by 10 feet, difficult terrain costs no extra movement when you Dash, and when you make a melee attack against a creature it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn.
Moderately Armored
Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.
Mounted Combatant

While mounted you have advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, you can redirect an attack aimed at your mount to yourself, and your mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save and half on a failure.
Observant
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can read lips, and you gain a +5 bonus to your passive Perception and passive Investigation.
Polearm Master

When you take the Attack action with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear you can use a bonus action to strike with the opposite end for 1d4 bludgeoning damage. You also get an opportunity attack when a creature enters your reach with such a weapon.
Resilient
Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency in saving throws with that ability.
Ritual Caster
You gain a ritual book holding two 1st-level ritual spells from a class you choose, and you can cast any ritual in it. You can add further rituals of a level you can cast to the book by copying them.
Sentinel

A creature you hit with an opportunity attack has its speed reduced to 0 for that turn, creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they Disengage, and when a creature within 5 feet attacks someone other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.
Sharpshooter

Attacking at long range gives you no disadvantage, your ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and before a ranged attack with a weapon you are proficient with you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll in exchange for +10 damage on a hit.
Shield Master

If you take the Attack action you can use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5 feet with your shield. You add your shield's AC bonus to Dexterity saves against effects that target only you, and you can use a reaction to take no damage on a successful Dexterity save.
Skulker
You can hide when lightly obscured, missing with a ranged attack does not reveal your position, and dim light does not impose disadvantage on your Perception checks that rely on sight.
Spell Sniper
The range of your attack-roll spells doubles, they ignore half and three-quarters cover, and you learn one attack cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard list.
Tavern Brawler

Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with improvised weapons, your unarmed strike deals 1d4 damage, and when you hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon you can use a bonus action to try to grapple.
Tough
Your hit point maximum increases by twice your level, and by 2 more each time you gain a level.
